sections.title: About You
sections.introduction: This section collects basic background information about you. Your answers will help describe the profile of respondents without revealing your identity.

sections.title: Phishing Investigation
sections.introduction: STEP 03: Inspect deceptive university emails, SMS alerts, scam calls, and malicious attachments to identify phishing threats.

sections.title: Pretexting Detection
sections.introduction: STEP 04: Detect fabricated emergency stories, fake authority claims, and social engineering pretexting calls.

sections.title: Impersonation Investigation
sections.introduction: STEP 05: Identify impersonation of university faculty, compromised classmate accounts, fake bank representatives, and spoofed telecom SMS.

sections.title: Scam & Malicious Link Investigation
sections.introduction: STEP 06: Identify fraudulent e-commerce deals, accommodation scams, fake payment links, malicious downloads, and fake internship offers.

questions.text: What is your age group?
What is your gender?
What is your current year of study?
What is your main field of study?
Have you received any formal training or education about cybersecurity or phishing?

You receive an email from 'it-support@campus-serendib-verify.example' stating your student inbox will be permanently deleted in 2 hours unless you confirm your password at an unverified link. How do you identify this?

options.label: Phishing email with credential harvesting link

questions.text: An SMS arrives on your phone: 'Campus Grant Notice: You have been awarded Rs. 45,000 in student aid. Tap http://serendib-edu-funds.xyz/claim immediately to enter your bank credentials and claim.' How do you identify this?

options.label: Phishing SMS (Smishing) with a malicious financial link
Official Ministry of Higher Education disbursement SMS
Routine student bank account verification message

questions.text: You receive a phone call where caller ID displays 'UNIVERSITY IT DESK'. The caller claims they detected a virus on your student portal and insists you read aloud the 6-digit verification code just texted to your phone. How do you identify this?

options.label: Phishing scam call (Vishing) attempting 2FA security code theft
Official campus IT helpdesk security troubleshooting call
Wrong number dialed by an off-campus department

questions.text: A campus cafeteria poster has a QR code claiming 'Scan here for 50% discount on student meal cards'. Scanning it opens a browser prompt warning that the link 'http://discount-pay-login.top' is insecure and demands your student login. How do you identify this?

options.label: Malicious QR code (Quishing) directing to a phishing login page
Temporary campus Wi-Fi network registration page

questions.text: An email with subject 'Revised End-Semester Exam Schedule & Seating Plan' arrives from an external Gmail address. It contains an attachment named 'Exam_Timetable_Final.pdf.exe'. How do you identify this?

options.label: Phishing email carrying an executable malware payload
Normal PDF document needing a specific reader

questions.text: You receive an urgent phone call from an unknown number. A caller claiming to be a Campus Security Officer says: 'Your student ID card was found at a crime scene off-campus. You must immediately pay a Rs. 10,000 clearance fine via mobile money or face police arrest.' How do you identify this?

options.label: Pretexting scam call using false authority and fear intimidation
Sri Lanka Police emergency notification procedure

questions.text: A caller claiming to be from the University Examination Directorate calls you at 8:00 PM: 'A system crash erased your exam registration. I need your LMS username, password, and national ID number right now over the phone to restore your eligibility.' How do you identify this?

options.label: Pretexting telephone scam (Vishing) fabricating an urgent academic crisis
Emergency university IT database recovery procedure
Routine telephone verification by the exams division

questions.text: You receive a WhatsApp message from an unknown number using the campus crest: 'Dear student, our scholarship donor wants to disburse Rs. 50,000 to you today, but you must first pay Rs. 3,500 processing fees through a digital gift card.' How do you identify this?

options.label: Pretexting advance-fee scam fabricating a fake scholarship donor

questions.text: Someone claiming to be a campus network technician calls your personal mobile: 'We are performing campus Wi-Fi maintenance. To keep your laptop connected, install this remote control tool (AnyDesk) and give me access.' How do you identify this?

options.label: Pretexting technical support scam seeking unauthorized remote access
Standard campus Wi-Fi speed optimization procedure

questions.text: A direct message arrives from someone claiming: 'I am a postgraduate researcher at your university conducting an urgent survey. If you share photos of your student ID and NIC, I will send you Rs. 5,000.' How do you identify this?

options.label: Pretexting identity-theft trap fabricating an academic research pretense

questions.text: You receive an email from 'prof.perera.dept.head@gmail.com' claiming to be your faculty Dean: 'I am in an urgent faculty meeting and cannot talk. Please buy Rs. 20,000 worth of Google Play gift cards and email the codes to me for campus guest speakers.' How do you identify this?

options.label: Executive impersonation scam spoofing a senior university official

questions.text: You receive a message from your close classmate's real Instagram account: 'Hey! I'm stuck in an emergency and my banking app isn't working. Can you immediately transfer Rs. 15,000 to this unknown account? I will repay you tomorrow.' How do you identify this?

options.label: Compromised classmate account used for social engineering impersonation
Genuine emergency request that you should immediately fund
Automatic Instagram student loan assistance feature

questions.text: You receive a phone call displaying a local commercial bank's customer service number. The caller says: 'This is Bank Fraud Prevention. We detected suspicious transactions on your student account. Please read your 16-digit debit card number, CVV code, and OTP to block the theft.' How do you identify this?

options.label: Bank impersonation scam call with caller ID spoofing
Legitimate bank security intervention protecting your funds
Regular university student bank account update

questions.text: A newly created Instagram profile named '@campus_official_students_union' with 12 followers sends you a DM claiming you won the annual university raffle and requests your student LMS credentials to credit the prize. How do you identify this?

options.label: Impersonation of a recognized campus student organisation
Valid inter-faculty student union voting contest

questions.text: An SMS from sender 'TELECOM-SL' states: 'University distance learning concession: Your student SIM has been selected for 100GB free data. Call +94 71 000 0000 or click http://free-student-data.site to register your NIC.' How do you identify this?

options.label: Telecom provider impersonation scam targeting student credentials and NIC
Official government distance learning telecommunications package
Standard mobile operator network upgrade notification

questions.text: A sponsored social media post advertises brand new Core i7 laptops for Rs. 15,000 (usually Rs. 200,000) under 'Campus Surplus Clearance'. The purchase link points to 'http://super-campus-deals.store/checkout'. How do you identify this?

options.label: E-commerce scam with a fraudulent shopping and payment link
Authentic clearance sale of university surplus equipment
Special government subsidized student hardware scheme

questions.text: You see an online listing for luxury student accommodation 50m from campus for Rs. 5,000/month. The landlord says: 'Send a refundable Rs. 20,000 deposit via bank transfer before viewing because 10 students are waiting.' How do you identify this?

options.label: Student accommodation rental scam with an advance fee trap
Official campus student welfare housing placement

questions.text: When paying semester tuition online, a link redirects to 'http://pay-serendib-portal.online/checkout'. The URL bar displays 'Not Secure', the campus crest is blurry, and it prompts for your ATM card PIN. How do you identify this?

options.label: Fake malicious payment gateway designed to steal banking and PIN credentials
Temporary backup payment server configured by campus finance

questions.text: A link shared in your student batch chat labeled 'Final_Exam_Seating_Arrangements_2026.pdf' redirects to 'http://tinyurl.example/update-flash-player' displaying a virus alert and forcing an executable file download. How do you identify this?

options.label: Malicious deceptive link attempting drive-by malware installation
Official document viewer plugin required for exam files
Standard security patch for student web browsers

questions.text: You receive a message on Telegram advertising a 'Guaranteed Work-From-Home Student Internship paying Rs. 80,000/month'. To register, you must tap a link and pay a Rs. 5,000 'mandatory onboarding documentation fee'. How do you identify this?

options.label: Fraudulent student employment scam using an advance fee link
